name: Original Blend

description: Bold and full-bodied, roasted dark for a rich, smoky finish. Perfect for the coffee lover who likes it strong. A 12oz bag of whole bean coffee.

description: Sweet vanilla and warm cinnamon spice folded into a light roast — cozy enough for a fall morning, gentle enough for every day. A 12oz bag of whole bean coffee.

name: Decaf House Blend
description: All the comfort of our house blend, none of the caffeine — smooth and balanced, any time of day. A 12oz bag of whole bean coffee.
